Relax pymongo[srv]==3.12.1 to pymongo>=4; absorb the pymongo 4 changes (#16) (#17)

* Relax pymongo[srv]==3.12.1 to >=4 (#16)

The fleet runs mongodol on pymongo 4.x; the exact pin was never enforced. CI keeps the mongo:5.0 service, which every 4.x supports.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* pymongo 4: id-only existence checks, UUID-safe scope comparison, pymongo 3's UUID layout for clients mongodol makes; plain pymongo>=4 (#16 review)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* pymongo 4 review round 2: UUID scope check uses the collection's codec, mk_client respects host=/lowercase options, empty getitem_projection (#16)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* mk_client: only a connection string's options choose a UUID layout (#16 review)
